scope: Development Validation seed screening; all completed seeds retained
typical_origin: Middle index of sorted205 frozen Validation origins, fixed before any completed candidate result
best_seed: Minimum completed pooled Validation RMSE; ascending seed tie break
top5: Five lowest completed Validation RMSE, or all if fewer than five
worst_segment: Maximum24step window RMSE of selected best seed; descriptive post-selection negative-case display, no exclusions
continuous_stitching: PROHIBITED; each trace belongs to one origin and its own24 future targets
horizon_aggregate: All valid seeds mean and min/max band plus selected best; spread is seed variability, not confidence interval
